data.one_liner: Official Pushy SDK for sending push notifications in Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: The official Pushy SDK for Flutter apps allows developers to integrate the Pushy push notification gateway. It provides tools to receive reliable push notifications across Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You are using Pushy as your push notification gateway
You need a reliable push notification service for real-time applications
avoid_when: You are using Firebase Cloud Messaging exclusively without Pushy
strengths: Official SDK for the Pushy gateway
weaknesses: Limited documentation included directly in the package README
data.setup_notes: Requires following detailed setup documentation on the Pushy website for platform-specific configuration.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications instead of Pushy.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using OneSignal for push notifications and user engagement.
